description.narrative: VDem distinguishes among 7 highlevel principles of democracy: electoral, liberal, participatory, majoritarian, consensual, deliberative and egalitarian, which are then further disaggregated into lowerlevels of democracy such as regular elections, direct democracy, gender equality and others.
